item.title: Record-low Danube River levels threaten shutdown of Hungary's nuclear plant
item.description: Three of four units of Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant were not in operation and the fourth was operating at about 50%, as of Wednesday morning.

item.title: SpaceX rocket booster crashes into the moon
item.description: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket booster crashed into the moon early Wednesday morning and is expected to leave a large crater on its surface. CBS News' Mark Strassmann has more.

item.title: Trump says Strait of Hormuz deal could happen as soon as today amid talks
item.description: President Trump told reporters Tuesday evening that an announcement on the Strait of Hormuz could happen today or tomorrow, following talks between Iran and Oman.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed backer on road ahead in Michigan Senate race after Haley Stevens defeat
item.description: Joseph Geevarghese, the executive director of Our Revolution, a progressive political action organization, joins CBS News to discuss his reaction to Abdul El-Sayed's success in Michigan's Democratic Senate primary.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed will face off against Mike Rogers in Michigan Senate race
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed is expected to move on to a general election race against Republican Mike Rogers. CBS News' Fin Gómez looks ahead.

item.title: How much can debt forgiveness save on a $20,000 balance this August?
item.description: Debt forgiveness can dramatically reduce what you owe, but the final savings aren't always what you'd expect.

item.title: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed projected to win Michigan Democratic Senate primary
item.description: Former state health official Abdul El-Sayed faced Rep. Haley Stevens in the Democratic Senate primary in Michigan in a closely watched contest that represented the latest test of the party's divisions.

item.title: Spokane resident reacts after Washington wildfires "completely devastated" her neighborhood
item.description: High temperatures are worsening wildfires in Washington as fire crews work to contain to flames. CBS News' Kris Van Cleave reports from Spokane.

item.title: Russian drone factory director seriously injured in car explosion
item.description: Vladimir Tkachuk has been pictured showcasing his drones to President Vladimir Putin.

item.title: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary, CBS News projects
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed, a progressive populist, beat Rep. Haley Stevens in Michigan's high-stakes Democratic Senate primary, CBS News projects. Ed O'Keefe has the latest.

item.title: U.S. has used nearly all of its stockpile of long-range precision missiles, sources say
item.description: There are new concerns over the United States' shrinking munitions stockpile. Sources say the U.S. has used nearly all of its global stockpile of long-range precision missiles during the war with Iran. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean explains.

item.title: Rubio says progress made on Strait of Hormuz as sources say U.S. missile stockpile is dwindling
item.description: President Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio both say talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz are progressing. This comes as the U.S. long-range missiles stockpile is running low, sources tell CBS News. CBS News' Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Disney partners with TikTok to offer creator content on its app
item.description: Disney and TikTok are teaming up to let users create short-form videos that draw on the entertainment giant's large stable of movies and TV shows.

item.title: What happens if you ignore medical bills?
item.description: Ignoring a medical bill can have consequences that extend far beyond the hospital or doctor's office. Here's why.

item.title: Cyclospora outbreak spreads to more states
item.description: The cyclospora outbreak has spread to more states. CBS News has confirmed cases linked to lettuce in Missouri and Arkansas. Dr. Celine Gounder explains what to know.

item.title: McKinney defeats Thanedar in Michigan's 13th Congressional District primary
item.description: Donavan McKinney has defeated incumbent U.S. Rep. Shri Thanedar in Michigan's 13th Congressional District, CBS News projects.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed beats Haley Stevens in Michigan's Democratic Senate primary, CBS News projects
item.description: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed beat moderate Rep. Haley Stevens in Michigan's Democratic Senate primary, CBS News projects. Aaron Navarro and Anthony Salvanto report.

item.title: "Peanut butter" pay raises are out, as employers shift to merit hikes
item.description: Here's what employees can expect for a raise in 2027 as companies move away from broad-based pay increases.

item.title: House Democrats targeting 12 new GOP districts, including Lauren Boebert's seat
item.description: With 90 days until the midterm elections, House Democrats are expanding the map of Republican-held congressional districts they believe they can potentially flip this fall.

item.title: "48 Hours" contributor in uncharted territory investigating murder case
item.description: In reporting on the case of Joe Shymanski, a Washington, D.C., photographer murdered in 2023, "48 Hours"' Nikki Battiste says the story took her into unfamiliar territory: confronting someone she grew up with.

item.title: Sneak peek: My Uncle Joe's Murder
item.description: ENCORE: A young woman mourns her uncle's murder … and questions whether the convicted killer was the only one involved. "48 Hours" contributor Nikki Battiste reports, Saturday, August 8 at 10/9c on CBS and streaming on Paramount+

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed says "there's a lot of healing to do" after Senate primary
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed​ is now projected to win Michigan's Democratic Senate primary​ against Rep. Haley Stevens.

item.title: Clancy murder trial sparks conversation about postpartum mental health
item.description: The Lindsay Clancy trial is creating a national conversation about postpartum mental health. Clancy is accused of killing her three young children. Prosecutors say she did it deliberately, but her defense argues she was suffering from postpartum psychosis. Dr. Kameelah Phillips and Dr. Catherine Birndorf discuss postpartum mental health and warning signs.

item.title: El-Sayed holds narrow lead in tight Michigan Democratic Senate primary race
item.description: Tuesday's Michigan Democratic Senate primary race remains unsettled, with progressive Abdul El-Sayed holding onto a narrow lead over moderate Haley Stevens with votes still being counted.

item.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized after livestreaming acts of self-harm, officials say
item.description: In the livestream, which has since been taken down, Hilton appears to be bloodied and in a distressed mental state.

item.title: Popular influencer shot dead during livestream outside restaurant
item.description: Cesar Gastelum, who had more than 600,000 followers on TikTok, was broadcasting with two friends when he was killed.

item.title: U.S. probes if Iran was behind cyberattack on utilities in Michigan, Minnesota
item.description: Malicious cyber activity affected technology at water systems in at least seven states this week, including Minnesota, leading authorities to dig into whether Iranian actors are behind the attack, CBS News has learned.

item.title: Trump blames Minnesota cyberattacks on its governor, not Iran
item.description: President Trump took his Cabinet meeting on the road to Camp David on Friday, where he downplayed cyberattacks on Minnesota water systems that U.S. officials suspect were linked to Iran. Nancy Cordes reports.
